nom: LOOPS Skincare Essentials Exfoliating Toner Pads

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing dry, rough skin and one with mature dry skin, report hydration, smoother texture, and improved acne scars without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the pads exfoliate gently without causing redness, dryness, stinging, or irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature dry skin reports strong hydration and refreshed, plumped-feeling skin after use.

concerns.aging: One mature-skin reviewer reports hydration and refreshed skin but does not mention fine lines or firmness specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the pads hydrate while exfoliating, calling out balanced hydration and refreshed, soaked-up moisture on dry skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say the pads do not cause it or that they help calm red areas; none report increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, stinging, or compromised feel after use, suggesting the pads are non-stripping.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports stress-hormonal acne calmed down after a week, and another reports improved acne scars on dry, rough skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reports on blemishes are limited to one mention of hormonal acne calming down and one of scar improvement; no reviewer reports new breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer specifically discusses oily or excess-sebum concerns.

aspects.libelle: Generous pad size and product amount

extraits.texte: These toning pads have genuinely helped my skin since I started using them in the last couple of weeks. They exfoliate nicely but very gently. I have extremely sensitive skin, and these don't irritate my skin at all.

I am amazed how well these toner pads hydrate my mature dry skin. My skin soaks it up. I place them on my face and let them sit then tap all over my face and neck. My skin feels refreshed and hydrated.
I was hesitant at first because my skin is sensitive, but these pads work wonders! They exfoliate without causing redness or dryness
I used these for a week and they calmed down my stress-hormonal acne!
loops pads are amazing and work great on my dry, rough skin - my acne scars have definitely improved
It was hard to open the seal on the products but the pads are great otherwise

I love that this toner gently exfoliates my skin and doesn't leave it red. I love using them as treatment pads and mini face masks - since the pad is such a bigger size compared to other toner pads! You need to follow up with the peptide serum to get that perfect glow.
